You are advising on Kalshi weather markets (daily HIGH/LOW ~19 US cities + hourly NYC temp). System has three layers already:

A) FAIR VALUE / LEARNING CELLS
- NWP ensemble + EMOS calibration + cell state machine LEARNING→PROBATION→ARMED
- 0 ARMED cells today; daily NO miscalibrated; hourly calibrated but negative edge after fees
- Engines only bet NO (taker)

B) FLOW / MICROSTRUCTURE (market_layers) — LIVE DATA 2026-07-25
- ml_book_snapshots: 36M+
- ml_trades: 704k
- ml_flow_signals: 144k (94k acted=would-have-traded)
- ml_signal_outcomes: 273k (1m/5m markouts)
- candles_book + ou_features_book: 7 days
- HistGB flow models never arm (label base rate 0.3–1.8% for drift-beyond-cost)
- Settlement experiment on 79,890 graded acted signals:
  baseline buy_NO mean PnL −0.54¢, win 46%
  micro_dev best−worst gap +6.3¢; aggression_w2m +5.3¢; signed_vol_w2m +1.1¢
  → rule shrink-gate wired (shrink-only {0,0.5,1.0} on those features)

C) MAKER EXECUTION — DESIGN ONLY until yesterday
- DESIGN_maker_execution_learning.md written; Stage 0 fill_sim.py just added (offline pessimistic/optimistic fill bounds over tape)
- Stage 1–2 NOT built: no exec_evidence logging, no exec cells, no live passive
- Economics claim: passive entry saves ~2–6¢/contract (spread + fee) vs taker, but adverse selection may erase it
- Design principle: never trade anything FV gate did not already license; same LEARNING→ARMED bars

PROPOSAL ON TABLE
1. Use existing 36M snaps + 704k trades + 94k acted signals to excavate whether maker (passive) entry would have been better than taker on the same FV decisions
2. Stage 1: log would-have-rested orders at every taker decision; grade offline with fill_sim; exec cells arm only on Wilson net_saving_c>0
3. Link to flow rule gate + FV cells so the three layers stack: FV whether → flow when/size → maker how (limit vs cross)

QUESTIONS
1) Best way to excavate a maker strategy from THIS existing data (no new collection required first)? Exact labels, filters, horizons, independence handling.
2) Ordered build plan that is safe (shadow-first) and reuses fill_sim + flow signals + settlement.
3) How to link maker cells with (a) FV learning cells, (b) flow shrink gate, (c) daily vs hourly, without double-counting edge or relaxing ARMED bars.
4) What to NOT do with this data.

Be concrete, ordered, short sections. Prefer reuse of existing tables/code.
